provenance.userPrompt: Build a complete open coastal hillside village around a blocked bay, with a centered rider-and-bicycle ground-play approximation entering downhill beneath a stone arch bridge and continuous land reaching a remote peninsula estate.

aiMetadata.description: Requested behavior: one seated rider-and-bicycle silhouette moves by land driving with forward movement, steering, and deceleration, without claiming true bicycle or vehicle physics. Implemented behavior: the complete rigid rider, hands, frame, and two-wheel silhouette is one controlled Subject using the current camera-relative supported-ground humanoid-medium closure; wheels and limbs are static and no cycling dynamics are claimed.
